title: Dinner Lady Strawberry Ice Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Strawberry Ice relives the refreshment of a juicy fruit punch served ice cold on a summer’s day. Think ripe, succulent strawberries tumbled into a sharp and zesty cloudy lemonade frosted just right for an irresistible fruit shock. This e-liquid’s nic salt formulation and perfectly balanced 50VG/50PG ratio makes it ideal for use in classic and starter e-cigarette kits or refillable pod systems , and its high nicotine content and smooth throat hit particularly suits recent ex-smokers who’ve swapped cigarettes for vaping. Details: 10ml Nicotine Salt E-Liquid Available 20mg nicotine strength 50VG/50PG (50%/50%)
